{"Author":"DhogGPT","Name":"Deep Ducking","Punchline":"Deep Ducking public host and authenticated module access.","Description":"The Deep Ducking public host provides the introduction, community links and authenticated loading of separately supplied DDuck modules. /deepducking and /dduck open the introduction when no module is loaded.

Full module required for all commands below except opening the host window.

Commands (use /deepducking; /dduck is an alias):
/deepducking [toggle main window]
/dduck [alias for /deepducking; accepts all commands below]
/deepducking mini [toggle Mini]
/deepducking settings [open Settings]
/deepducking config [open Settings]
/deepducking debug [reveal and open Advanced for this plugin load]
/deepducking help [open command help]
/deepducking start [floor] [start or continue selected save; optional fresh-run floor]
/deepducking party-start [floor] [alias for start]
/deepducking party [select fixed-party POTD while idle]
/deepducking adopt [bind eligible already-entered party dungeon]
/deepducking hold [pause local output; retain run for Resume]
/deepducking resume [resume retained local run after readiness checks]
/deepducking nextstop [exit after next boss]
/deepducking ns [exit after next boss]
/deepducking stop [FULL STOP; persist local lock across reloads; stay in duty]
/deepducking reset-stop [clear eligible FULL STOP after cleanup; do not start]
/deepducking status [print local status]
/deepducking inspect [record read-only client and native observations]
/deepducking saves [open Saves]
/deepducking saves info <dungeon> [inspect native saves]
/deepducking saves delete <dungeon> <1|2> [delete selected save after native checks; no extra confirmation]
/deepducking saves dof <dungeon> <1|2> <on|off> [set future-failure deletion preference; no deletion now]
/deepducking saves cancel [cancel pending save or Start preparation; completed actions remain]

Dungeon arguments: potd, hoh, eo, pt. [floor] is optional; <...> is required. Choose one value for 1|2 or on|off; omit brackets when typing. Start can replace stopped state; Resume can release an eligible retained in-dungeon run. nextstop and ns retain the save and keep Mini open until return is observed; repeat to confirm the same request. Use the existing boss-break button to cancel.

If DailyDuty is installed, /dd is unavailable for Deep Ducking; use /deepducking. - Main Scenario pacing. The Main Scenario rate stops at the final Main Scenario quest, so play after it does not change the rate. The classic window now shows the Main Scenario row too.

- Fix: the FINAL FANTASY XVI crossover, The Path Infernal, showed twice in Active Events, once as "Festival #147". It now shows once, with its name.
- The AI declaration is corrected and complete, and "tracker" is removed from the plugin's tags.
Adventurer's Ledger (Pandora Lunar):
- Hunt counts on the Hunts tab. After an import from this version, each A and S rank group shows the game's count beside your ticks, for example "The game counts 5 of 6; you have ticked 4". It never ticks anything.
- Armor cards. The Armor frame shows one card for each armor set, with "3 of 5 slots" for each role or job that holds a piece. The full grid is inside each card.
- GARO weapon card. The GARO frame shows the GARO weapons as a line card, like Weapons and Tools. The GARO armor grid is below it.
- Where a relic line starts. When the starting quest of a relic line is not open yet, the card names the first quest to do on the way to it.
- Custom Deliveries boxes. The Custom Deliveries routine has 12 boxes, one for each weekly delivery. Each box also counts for The Customer Is Always Right in the Challenge Log.
- Weekly meter. The Weekly meter now counts Challenge Log entries that you completed in the last 4 weeks, beside your weekly routines.
- Crafting solver. The Jobs area has a crafting solver that finds a rotation for one recipe. It is built from Raphael (Apache-2.0) and runs in your browser.
- Moved notice. The old github.io address shows a notice that the Ledger has moved, with a Download backup button.

- The 4 material quests: the market pre-buy bought Labor of Love's Perfect Pestle and Perfect Mortar again (76,650 gil) after they were handed in at step 6. What each quest still needs now follows its current step, from the quest data: the HQ crafted items until their own hand-in (Labor of Love step 6, Method in His Malice step 9, the other two at the end), the first hand-in's items until step 1, and the last bought items until the quest is done. The pre-buy, the purchases before a hand-in and the HQ check all use this.
- The 4 material quests: WigglyQuest can hand in several steps in one go. Labor of Love was handed over at step 5 and went on to its last hand-in, a Bombard core and a bottle of sacred spring water, with no water held, so it stood at Guiding Star. When a quest reaches its last hand-ins while WigglyQuest runs it and an item is missing, ZodiacHelper now stops WigglyQuest, buys the item and hands the quest back. It never does this during a hand-in talk.
- Market board trips: every world change from the Ul'dah board paid a teleport to the aetheryte. The free hop through the Sapphire Avenue Exchange shard only ran in Steps of Nald (territory 130), but the board and the shard are in Steps of Thal (131), per the Aetheryte sheet. It now runs from Steps of Thal, and the log notes each hop.
- Second relic roadmap: the first hand-ins of the 4 material quests no longer list the HQ crafted items. The quest objectives in the game data ask for them at the end of each quest (A Ponze of Flesh step 7, Labor of Love 7, Method in His Malice 8, A Treasured Mother 8), so the last roadmap step now lists them, with the Bombard Core, Sacred Spring Water and Furite Sand that Guiding Star and Adkin ask for after them.
- BossMod as combat plugin in a map run: LootGoblin puts its own preset back every few seconds during the fight, which left the job without a rotation in between. The preset with the job's rotation is now checked every second instead of every 5, and the log notes it once per fight.
- Combat plugin set to BossMod: a White Mage stood still at a map coffer. LootGoblin 1.1.1.16 activates its "FRENRIDER - RANGED" preset, which has no WHM rotation, and holds back BossMod's AI for a healer without God Mod Companion. ZodiacHelper now checks that the active BossMod preset has a rotation for the current job. If it does not, it sets the first one that does: your last preset, "VBM Default", "AutoDuty" or the FRENRIDER presets. If none has it, the log says so once.
- New Settings option "Combat plugin": Auto, Rotation Solver, BossMod autorotation or Wrath Combo. Auto keeps the old behaviour (Rotation Solver when loaded, else BossMod). The choice applies to Atma FATEs, books, leves, quest kills, self-defence, the Alexandrite map farm and every duty. AutoDuty gets it as its rotation plugin for the run. DAD has no such setting, so during a DAD run, and during LootGoblin's map runs, ZodiacHelper turns the picked plugin on after 3 seconds in combat with it off. BossMod's AI still does the movement. Wrath Combo is driven through its lease IPC and has not been tried in game yet.
- Alexandrite map farm: when LootGoblin's Landing command triggers switch Rotation Solver off ("/rotation cancel" then only "/bmrai on"), the trap mobs from a coffer hit the player and nothing fought back. After 3 seconds in combat with Rotation Solver off, the farm turns it to Auto through its IPC, on enemies that already have a target, so it does not pull other mobs near the coffer. Rotation Solver's saved settings are not changed.
- Cutscene skip no longer presses Escape outside a cutscene. In Sastasha the coral switch ("You find a switch. Press it?") counts as an event, so each Escape closed the prompt with "Event canceled" and AutoDuty stood at the coral. Escape is now sent only while a cutscene plays and never while a Yes/No prompt is open.
- Allied Seals now buy Alexandrite only in lots of 5 (250 seals), the same as one Mysterious Map gives. With 50 to 249 seals the autopilot used to count them, and the Novus step read "15 map(s) for 74 Alexandrite" with no Alexandrite held. Leftover seals under 250 are no longer counted or spent.
- Jalzahn's Atma to Animus no longer fails after the 9 books. The book runner hands the weapon to Jalzahn itself, and his trip switches to another gearset to take the relic off. The autopilot then ran its job switch, which put Thyrus Atma back in the hands, and Jalzahn refused it. The autopilot now waits until Jalzahn is done, and Jalzahn checks the hands again before each talk.
- Atma farm with Rotation Solver and BossMod off: an enemy from outside the FATE that hits you is no longer targeted while you are synced in the FATE. Rotation Solver's IgnoreNonFateInFate setting, on by default, never attacks it, so in manual mode the character stood looking at it and the FATE timed out. The farm now goes for the FATE's enemies.
- Book FATEs keep the enemy already targeted instead of picking the nearest again every moment, which flipped between two Ixali and walked the player back and forth. Line of sight now uses the game's own check for spells ("Target not in line of sight"); the scenery ray of 0.8.59 called open ground blocked.
- Line of sight: the book run (enemies, leves) and the Atma farm no longer stop at range when a rock or wall stands between the player and the target; they walk closer until it is in sight. The book run also picks an enemy in sight first. A Dullahan behind a rock in the North Shroud kept the player standing still.
- Labor of Love: the path now rides on the ground to the front of Guiding Star's stall in Mor Dhona and talks from there. WigglyQuest flew onto the stall roof, 3.9 yalms above her, and gave up the hand-in.
- Escort leve (Someone's in the Doghouse): when the escort does not move for 12 seconds after a /beckon, the player walks back down to it and leads it again 6 yalms to one side, then the other. Before, it beckoned from a rock the mine hound could not reach for 9 minutes.
- Book run: a walk or ride that stops moving for 6 seconds now steps aside and takes the route again, and after three tries sets that target aside. The walk to K'leytai in Mor Dhona stood still for 26 minutes.
- Zodiac material quests: a quest WigglyQuest failed to take was marked done for the weapon, because the game still lists it complete from the first weapon. Now a quest counts as done only after it was in the journal.
- Sylphlands Sentinel: the book run flies to a fixed open spot near the sentinels and lands there. Before, it flew to them under the Sylphlands trees and hovered without landing.
- Second weapon check: the material quests alongside the books now also count a character as past its first relic by the achievements Lethal Weapon (Obtain a Zodiac Weapon) or The Letter Z, or by a Zodiac or Zeta weapon held, besides "Wherefore Art Thou, Zodiac". - Autopilot Poetics plan: with the material quests alongside the books, the 2 Sacred Spring Waters of the first hand-ins (A Ponze of Flesh, A Treasured Mother, 400 Poetics) count toward the Animus step, so the ARF run before the books covers them. - Zodiac material quests: the plugin takes them itself by talking to Papana, Guiding Star, Adkin and Brangwine. WigglyQuest answered "Could not retrieve next quest step" on A Ponze of Flesh and the character stood still. WigglyQuest still does the hand-ins. The quest talks no longer answer Yes to a prompt that is not from the NPC, such as the Lodestone playguide one.
- Books count per weapon. The game keeps one book at a time, bound to one weapon, and the Bravura's finished Skyearth I read as the Thyrus' ninth book: the autopilot sent the Thyrus Atma to Jalzahn with no books done. The 9 books now count as done only when G'jusana shows every set complete for the weapon in hand. A finished book, or one of a weapon past the books, is thrown away when she offers it for the next one. An unfinished book of another weapon stops the purchase and says so.
- Relic gearset: your own gearsets are never written any more. With the relic in hand on a gearset that saves another weapon you still have, a new gearset is made for the relic, as the Novus step already did. 0.8.48 and earlier overwrote the WHM gearset with the unfinished Thyrus. A gearset that saves a relic or a weapon that is gone is still updated. During A Relic Reborn, when WigglyQuest puts your own gearset on, the relic gearset goes back on.
- Jalzahn trips: the gearset switch that takes the relic off skips gearsets whose weapon is gone. The WHM gearset still held the unfinished Thyrus after the Zenith trade, the game asked "Replace it with Thyrus Zenith?" and the trip stopped. The relic gearset option now also saves a later stage of the relic over a weapon that is gone.
- Books: new option "Zodiac material quests alongside the books", off by default, for a second weapon on. - Atma farm: FATEs that last more than 15 minutes, like Lazy for You at 30 minutes, are left for others. They are made for many players. A checkbox under the Atma farm turns this off.
- Report a problem: the .log file now starts with a Now section (zone, position, job, WigglyQuest's quest and step, the autopilot's step, the job list and every runner at work) and also keeps WigglyQuest's lines and the warnings of other plugins. A line that repeats within a minute is counted instead of written again.
- A Relic Reborn, step 10 (the quest enemies): the character stood still in Outer La Noscea because the spawn centre is off the navmesh. It now looks up to 60 y around it for a spot it can walk to and waits there.
- Mini window and status: while A Relic Reborn runs, they show the quest step out of 19 and what it asks for (for example step 7 of 19, Amdapor Keep). Before, the mini window showed no progress for a job without a relic, and the status kept an old restart note.
- A Relic Reborn on a second job: the step that examines the destination at the Weeping Saint (Chimera) or the Hall of the Bestiarii (Hydra) is skipped when the destination is gone. It is gone once an earlier relic opened the trial, and WigglyQuest waited on it until it gave up.
- A Relic Reborn: once Gerolt has the weapon (sequence 4 on), the autopilot no longer buys and melds another one. The Main tab lists it as handed in.
- Mini window: the Mahatma bars from 0.8.37 never showed, and the window stopped drawing after the step line while the Mahatmas were farmed. Fixed.

- Mini window: while the Mahatmas are farmed it shows the weapon's Mahatmas out of 12 and the attached Mahatma's points out of 40.

- Animus to Novus takes the Animus out of your hands before talking to Jalzahn. With it equipped, the game refused the enhancement and the step stopped after 45 seconds.
- Gear repair, on by default: between targets of the books, the Atma farm and between autopilot steps, a worn piece at or below 30 % (set in the main tab) gets repaired. - On a Free Trial account the materia row of the main tab says "by hand (Free Trial)" instead of "autopilot", since nothing is bought on the market board there.

- Capture leves also take an armour piece off when one hit removes more than 30 % of a target's HP, before it can die. A level 70 summoner took a winter nix from 100 % to 42 % with one auto-attack.

- Capture leves keep your armour on at first. Each target that dies before the /soothe takes one more piece off for that job and level, body and legs first, and the count is saved. A level 100 character may lose a few targets the first time while it learns.
- Free Trial accounts skip every market board purchase and the main tab says so, since the game does not let them use the market board.
- Capture leves no longer switch to normal combat after riding to the next target. Before, the AI came back on and attacked a winter nix that was already pacified.
- Capture leves start the auto-attack with the hotbar's Auto-attack command. The old call got "Cannot execute at this time." with the weak weapon on, so the targets were never hit.
- Capture leves send the chocobo away and turn off the BossMod AI, its preset and Rotation Solver, even when you had them on. Only the auto-attack hits the targets, so a skill or the chocobo no longer kills one before the /soothe.
- Capture leves in the books no longer swap between the weak weapon and the Atma weapon every second. The Atma weapon goes back on after the targets are soothed, before the turn-in.
- The books summon the chocobo companion with Gysahl Greens for their enemies and FATEs, as the Atma farm already did. Leves stay without it, so it cannot kill a capture target.
- Escort leves (Someone's in the Doghouse): when the escort falls more than 20 yalms behind, the character walks back to it. It used to stay up to 30 yalms ahead, stuck on a rock, sending /beckon that the game answered with "Too far away".
- Dungeon unlocks that need another dungeon cleared first (Halatali before Halatali (Hard)) wait until you are out of it. The clear used to count when the last boss died, so the talk to Hugubert started inside Halatali, three teleports failed, and the book stopped on Mumuepo the Beholden.
- Trips to an NPC wait up to 3 minutes for a duty or cutscene to end before teleporting.
- Lure leves (Don't Forget to Cry): a prime location that lures nothing within 8 seconds is skipped. It used the lure on the same wrong spot every 5 seconds.
- New "Dungeon coffers" option in the Debug tab for book, Braves and unlock dungeons: boss coffers only (default), every coffer, no coffers, or your own DAD/AutoDuty loot settings.
- FATE combat after a dungeon: AutoDuty/DAD turn the BossMod AI off and clear its autorotation preset. /vbmai on is now sent again after each zone change, and without Rotation Solver your last preset (or VBM Default) is set for the fight and cleared after it.
- Atma FATEs inside the U'Ghamaro Mines are done on the ground; the mount stays off past the entrance.

- Capture leves in the books no longer swap between the weak weapon and the Atma weapon every second. The Atma weapon goes back on after the targets are soothed, before the turn-in.
- The books summon the chocobo companion with Gysahl Greens for their enemies and FATEs, as the Atma farm already did. Leves stay without it, so it cannot kill a capture target.
- Escort leves (Someone's in the Doghouse): when the escort falls more than 20 yalms behind, the character walks back to it. It used to stay up to 30 yalms ahead, stuck on a rock, sending /beckon that the game answered with "Too far away".
- Dungeon unlocks that need another dungeon cleared first (Halatali before Halatali (Hard)) wait until you are out of it. The clear used to count when the last boss died, so the talk to Hugubert started inside Halatali, three teleports failed, and the book stopped on Mumuepo the Beholden.
- Trips to an NPC wait up to 3 minutes for a duty or cutscene to end before teleporting.
- Lure leves (Don't Forget to Cry): a prime location that lures nothing within 8 seconds is skipped. It used the lure on the same wrong spot every 5 seconds.
- New "Dungeon coffers" option in the Debug tab for book, Braves and unlock dungeons: boss coffers only (default), every coffer, no coffers, or your own DAD/AutoDuty loot settings.
- FATE combat after a dungeon: AutoDuty/DAD turn the BossMod AI off and clear its autorotation preset. /vbmai on is now sent again after each zone change, and without Rotation Solver your last preset (or VBM Default) is set for the fight and cleared after it.
- Atma FATEs inside the U'Ghamaro Mines are done on the ground; the mount stays off past the entrance.
- Jalzahn's furnace is used from (445.9, -66.3), where it worked by hand. When WigglyQuest hovers at Gerolt or the furnace, it lands and walks in.
- The "Do you really want to trade a high-quality item?" prompt is answered on quests Zodiac Helper started.
- Main tab: materia and the class weapon read "autopilot" when market buying is on.

{"Author":"XivHub","Name":"AutoPincher","Punchline":"One-click retainer repricing against the live market board, fully local.","Description":"Repinches your retainer market listings by undercutting the cheapest live competitor by 1 gil. Reads each listing straight from game memory, clicks the in-game market board's Compare Prices to find the current cheapest offering, and sets your asking price to one below it, never below what a vendor gives, and never above your own cheapest copy. Your own retainers and housing mannequins are never treated as competitors, so two retainers selling the same item don't chase each other down. - Hunting Log window (`/hunt`). A new optional feature. Type `/hunt`, or switch it on in Settings. The window shows every Hunting Log monster that you still need, for all your unlocked classes and your Grand Company at the same time. You do not have to change class to see a class's log. Each row shows the class, the task, the monster, your kills and where to find it. Finished monsters, finished ranks and locked classes are not shown.
- Map flags for Hunting Log monsters. Click Flag on a row to open the map at that monster. If the monster is also in your current zone, the row shows that location. The locations come from the Hunty plugin by Infiziert90 (MIT License).
- Current class only and Current zone only. Two check boxes in the Hunting Log window. With Current zone only, the window shows only the monsters in the zone where you are, for all classes. The window updates when you change class or zone.
- Change class from the Hunting Log. In the summary line at the top of the window, click a class name to equip a gear set for that class. If you have more than one gear set for the class, a list opens and you select one. The game's own Gear Set function does the change, the same as a click in the Gear Set window. Nothing is sent to chat.
- Hunting Log in the export. The export has a new `huntLog` block with each class's rank and kill counts. The Adventurer's Ledger reads it.
- Leve markers. In the quest list, a leve whose items are in your bags now shows "[R]" in place of a check mark. The check mark means "complete" in the News panel. Hold the pointer on a leve row to see what "> " and "[R]" mean.
- Fix: allied societies in the mini window. The society list shows only societies that are capped and wait for a main quest. Societies at their last rank are not listed.
Adventurer's Ledger (Pandora Lunar):
- Hunting Log. Jobs has a Hunting Log frame. It shows each class's rank, its tasks complete, and the monsters it still needs, with the place. Import a Tales of Milestones export to fill it in.
- Gear guide. Jobs has a Gear guide frame. Select one job and level. It shows the highest item level for each slot from the sources that you tick, with options for your export, crafting, NPC vendors and the market board.
- Mentor Roulette readiness. The Mentor tab has a Roulette frame, also listed under Jobs and Duties. It shows the Battle Mentor requirements: the level 100 role quests, a combat job at level 100, and each duty in the game's Mentor Roulette pool cleared once. Missing duties are listed by expansion and type. Item level 755 is a manual check, because the export does not have it.
- Import preview: Challenge Log. When an export opens new Challenge Log entries, the import preview shows them, for example "Challenge Log entries open: 40 → 41 (new: Soul Survivor I)".
- Allied societies. When every society in a group is at its last rank and the Intersocietal Quests are done, the group shows only the names, ranks and the quest check box.
- Fix: Ocean Fishing clock. The bar shows the time as "29:58" again, not "00:29:58".
- Fix: new characters. A new character no longer stops the Quest items frame after you enter a crafter or gatherer level. "Mark items HQ" is on by default again.
- Fix: backup import. A backup with no characters no longer leaves the page empty until a reload.
- Fix: Challenge Log. The Challenge Log list now comes from the game's data, so it matches the game after a patch.
- Fix: smaller items. The Collections filter (All, Owned, Missing) keeps its selection when you change area. Collapsed sections stay collapsed. Ended events leave the events feed. The time zone and hunt switches work with Space and Enter.
- Faster pages. The Ledger draws only the area and frame on screen."}

{"Author":"DhogGPT","Name":"Deep Ducking","Punchline":"Deep Ducking public host and authenticated module access.","Description":"The Deep Ducking public host provides the introduction, community links and authenticated loading of separately supplied DDuck modules. /deepducking and /dduck open the introduction when no module is loaded.

Commands (use /deepducking; /dduck is an alias):
/deepducking [toggle main window]
/dduck [alias for /deepducking; accepts all commands below]
/deepducking mini [toggle Mini]
/deepducking settings [open Settings]
/deepducking config [open Settings]
/deepducking debug [reveal and open Advanced for this plugin load]
/deepducking help [open command help]
/deepducking start [floor] [start or continue selected save; optional fresh-run floor]
/deepducking party-start [floor] [alias for start]
/deepducking party [select fixed-party POTD while idle]
/deepducking adopt [bind eligible already-entered party dungeon]
/deepducking hold [pause local output; retain run for Resume]
/deepducking resume [resume retained local run after readiness checks]
/deepducking nextstop [exit after next boss]
/deepducking ns [exit after next boss]
/deepducking stop [FULL STOP; persist local lock across reloads; stay in duty]
/deepducking reset-stop [clear eligible FULL STOP after cleanup; do not start]
/deepducking status [print local status]
/deepducking inspect [record read-only client and native observations]
/deepducking saves [open Saves]
/deepducking saves info <dungeon> [inspect native saves]
/deepducking saves delete <dungeon> <1|2> [delete selected save after native checks; no extra confirmation]
/deepducking saves dof <dungeon> <1|2> <on|off> [set future-failure deletion preference; no deletion now]
/deepducking saves cancel [cancel pending save or Start preparation; completed actions remain]

Dungeon arguments: potd, hoh, eo, pt. [floor] is optional; <...> is required. Choose one value for 1|2 or on|off; omit brackets when typing.
